hooks.name: Lint + type-check on TS/TSX save
hooks.description: Runs eslint and a TypeScript type-check whenever a .ts/.tsx file is saved, matching the documented verify loop.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/node-v24.22.1-darwin-arm64/bin:$PATH"; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && npm run lint && npx tsc -b --noEmit 2>/dev/null || npx tsc -b
